title: Inverse Garment Design with Visual Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.15582v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the problem of inverse garment design, reconstructing simulation-ready 3D outfits with arbitrary layers from a single image, with visual agents. Unlike differentiable optimization that is time-consuming, or feed-forward methods limited by training data, we introduce DressAgent, a hierarchical agentic system that recovers garment sewing patterns through planning and closed-loop refinement grounded in physical simulation. To this end, we first present an enhanced representation based on GarmentCode for diverse styles and arbitrary dressing layers, and build the first multi-layer sewing pattern dataset with over 15K outfits for supervision and benchmarking. Inverse design then proceeds coarse to fine: In layer planning and coarse estimation, agents infer layer order and relations, peel each layer into its own view, and estimate coarse patterns. In fine-grained refinement, an agentic trio of Tailor, Critic, and Orchestrator refines

translated_title: 基于视觉智能体的逆向服装设计
translated_abstract: 我们研究逆向服装设计问题，即利用视觉智能体从单张图像重建可用于仿真的、具有任意穿着层次的3D服装。与耗时的可微优化方法或受训练数据限制的前馈方法不同，我们提出了DressAgent——一个分层智能体系统，通过基于物理仿真的规划与闭环细化来恢复服装缝纫版型。为此，我们首先提出了一个基于GarmentCode的增强表示，以支持多样化的服装风格和任意穿着层次，并构建了首个包含超过1.5万套服装的多层缝纫版型数据集，用于监督与基准测试。逆向设计由粗到细地进行：在层次规划与粗估计阶段，智能体推断各层的顺序与关系，将每层服装分离到各自的视图中，并估计粗略版型；在细粒度细化阶段，由裁缝、评论家和编排者组成的智能体三人组对版型进行细化。
tldr: 提出DressAgent——一个基于视觉智能体的分层系统，通过物理仿真驱动的规划与闭环细化，从单张图像重建具有任意层次、可直接用于仿真的3D服装，并构建了首个包含1.5万余套服装的多层缝纫版型数据集。
en_tdlr: DressAgent, a hierarchical visual-agent system that reconstructs simulation-ready, arbitrarily-layered 3D garments from a single image via physically-grounded planning and closed-loop refinement, supported by the first multi-layer sewing pattern dataset of over 15K outfits.
